question: Which named powers are included among the nine powers of the seat?
premises: Prabhā, Satyā, Īśānā, and Anugrahā are named.
They belong to a group of nine powers.
The verse enumerates members of that group.
inference: Prabhā, Satyā, Īśānā, and Anugrahā are among the nine powers.
uncertainties: Only four of the nine powers are explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: Prabhā, Satyā, Īśānā, and Anugrahā are among the nine powers.
